findings.title: ScanMemo now retains one KeyedUsage per Claude response for every file in the 7-day window
findings.evidence: Raised by Hígia reviewing BUG-ART-001: Entry.keyed holds a record per (message.id, requestId); bounded by the 7-day window and memo.retain(paths:), but resident size is unmeasured on heavy users.
findings.fix: Measure memo resident size on a large ~/.claude/projects; consider compact per-key structs.
findings.origin: new_findings from the 3-lens code review panel

findings.title: Memo-replay dedup test cannot detect a fix that forgets to store keyed records in the memo
findings.evidence: Raised by Nêmesis reviewing BUG-ART-001: the cross-file memo test uses two files with the same record, so a variant that drops keyed from the memo still yields 100/50.
findings.fix: Add a replay test with a single keyed file or distinct keys across files.
findings.origin: new_findings from the 3-lens code review panel

findings.title: Analytics lists opencode models as $0.00 rows while the popover footer shows the cost opencode recorded
findings.evidence: Raised by Jano reviewing BUG-ART-002: mergingOpencode inserts 0 for opencode models; CostFooterView.swift:198 shows costLast7DaysByModel; README.md:31 promises the recorded cost as a breakdown for pay-per-token traffic.
findings.fix: Show tokens only (skip $0 rows) or show recorded cost as a non-additive breakdown so both views agree.

findings.title: make validate showed a transient test failure (2 unnamed issues) that passed on immediate re-run
findings.evidence: Observed by Ferreiro during BUG-ART-002: first make validate failed with 2 test issues not named by the gate output; full swift test right after passed 836/836 and a rerun of make validate was green. Likely related to TEST-ARG-007 (real api.github.com call + 50 ms wall-clock window).
findings.fix: Make the gate print failing test names; fix TEST-ARG-007; track flaky tests.
findings.origin: new_findings from the 3-lens code review panel

findings.title: hdiutil attach that mounted but returned no mount point (or was killed after mounting) is never detached
findings.evidence: Raised by Nêmesis reviewing SEC-CER-001: detach only runs when a mount point was parsed; a timeout-kill after mount or a plist without mount-point leaks a device node under the temp root.
findings.fix: Detach by device node from the plist, or run hdiutil detach on the -mountrandom root on every failure path.
findings.origin: new_findings from the 3-lens code review panel

findings.title: Code-signature requirement checks are hand-written in three places
findings.evidence: Raised by Hígia reviewing SEC-CER-001: CodexResetProcess.trustedExecutable, CodeSignatureInfo and TeamSignatureDMGVerifier.checkSignature each build SecStaticCode + SecRequirement; only the DMG one uses kSecCSCheckNestedCode.
findings.fix: Consolidate into one Core helper taking (url, requirement, flags).
findings.origin: new_findings from the 3-lens code review panel

findings.title: Fail-closed update checksum makes the checksums upload in make publish a hard requirement with no guard
findings.evidence: Raised by Jano reviewing SEC-CER-001: a release published by hand without checksums-X.Y.Z.txt would make every in-app update fail with updates_no_checksum.
findings.fix: Have make publish assert the checksums asset exists before flipping draft to published.
findings.origin: new_findings from the 3-lens code review panel

findings.title: UpdateCheckerDownloadTests leave temp directories and UserDefaults suites behind; one test sits in a misnamed suite
findings.fix: Remove temp dirs/suites in teardown; move quarantine_failure_throws to the UpdateChecker suite.
